typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberNum as string,
		Phone as string,
		UnitJob as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId derive(MemberNum_NonUnicode = toString(MemberNum),
		Phone_NonUnicode = toString(Phone),
		UnitJob_NonUnicode = toString(UnitJob)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_UNITJOB_NAME as string,
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE as string,
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_UNITJOB_NAME = UnitJob_NonUnicode,
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum_NonUnicode,
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE = Phone_NonUnicode,
		UNITJOBLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID)) ~> PDSUNITJOBLISTSTAGING
